// Papierwerk source excerpt, Copyright (c) 2026 gentrax, MIT.
// Commit 4ec40a640dec268d2cdf34a77b1d8d2983377bbd; original line ranges 770-802, 829-848, 936-1031.
function mulberry32(a){
  return function(){
    a |= 0; a = a + 0x6D2B79F5 | 0;
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ a >>> 15, 1 | a);
    t = t + Math.imul(t ^ t >>> 7, 61 | t) ^ t;
    return ((t ^ t >>> 14) >>> 0) / 4294967296;
  };
}

function smoothstep(t){ return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); }

/* Eine Value-Noise-Oktave: kleines Zufallsgitter, glatt hochskaliert. */
function noiseOctave(w, h, cell, rnd){
  const gw = Math.max(2, Math.round(w / cell) + 1);
  const gh = Math.max(2, Math.round(h / cell) + 1);
  const g = new Float32Array(gw * gh);
  for (let i = 0; i < g.length; i++) g[i] = rnd();

  const out = new Float32Array(w * h);
  const sx = (gw - 1) / w, sy = (gh - 1) / h;
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++){
    const fy = y * sy, y0 = Math.min(gh - 2, fy | 0);
    const ty = smoothstep(fy - y0);
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++){
      const fx = x * sx, x0 = Math.min(gw - 2, fx | 0);
      const tx = smoothstep(fx - x0);
      const a = g[y0 * gw + x0],       b = g[y0 * gw + x0 + 1];
      const c = g[(y0 + 1) * gw + x0], d = g[(y0 + 1) * gw + x0 + 1];
      out[y * w + x] = (a + (b - a) * tx) * (1 - ty) + (c + (d - c) * tx) * ty;
    }
  }
  return out;
}

function smoothNoise(w, h, cell, seed, octaves = 3){
  const rnd = mulberry32(seed);
  const total = new Float32Array(w * h);
  let amp = 1, ampSum = 0, c = cell;
  for (let o = 0; o < octaves; o++){
    const n = noiseOctave(w, h, Math.max(2, c), rnd);
    for (let i = 0; i < n.length; i++) total[i] += n[i] * amp;
    ampSum += amp; amp *= 0.5; c /= 2.3;
  }
  let mean = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < total.length; i++){ total[i] /= ampSum; mean += total[i]; }
  mean /= total.length;
  let mx = 1e-6;
  for (let i = 0; i < total.length; i++){
    total[i] -= mean;
    const a = Math.abs(total[i]); if (a > mx) mx = a;
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < total.length; i++) total[i] /= mx;
  return total;
}

/* Exakte euklidische Distanztransformation (Felzenszwalb, separabel).
   Eine Chamfer-Naeherung liegt hier bis zu 1.3 px daneben — das reicht, um
   den Rissrand sichtbar zu verziehen, also wird exakt gerechnet. */
function edt1d(f, n, d, v, z){
  let k = 0; v[0] = 0; z[0] = -Infinity; z[1] = Infinity;
  for (let q = 1; q < n; q++){
    let s = ((f[q] + q*q) - (f[v[k]] + v[k]*v[k])) / (2*q - 2*v[k]);
    while (s <= z[k]){
      k--;
      s = ((f[q] + q*q) - (f[v[k]] + v[k]*v[k])) / (2*q - 2*v[k]);
    }
    k++; v[k] = q; z[k] = s; z[k+1] = Infinity;
  }
  k = 0;
  for (let q = 0; q < n; q++){
    while (z[k+1] < q) k++;
    const dq = q - v[k];
    d[q] = dq*dq + f[v[k]];
  }
}

function distanceOutside(alpha, w, h){
  const INF = 1e12;
  const sq = new Float64Array(w * h);
  for (let i = 0; i < sq.length; i++) sq[i] = alpha[i] > 110 ? 0 : INF;

  const n = Math.max(w, h);
  const f = new Float64Array(n), d = new Float64Array(n);
  const v = new Int32Array(n), z = new Float64Array(n + 1);

  for (let x = 0; x < w; x++){                 // Spalten
    for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) f[y] = sq[y*w + x];
    edt1d(f, h, d, v, z);
    for (let y = 0; y < h; y++) sq[y*w + x] = d[y];
  }
  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++){                 // Zeilen
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) f[x] = sq[y*w + x];
    edt1d(f, w, d, v, z);
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++) sq[y*w + x] = d[x];
  }

  const out = new Float32Array(w * h);
  for (let i = 0; i < out.length; i++) out[i] = Math.sqrt(sq[i]);
  return out;
}

/* Legt den weissen Ausriss hinter das Sprite und liefert ein neues RGBA-Bild. */
function addTornBorder(sp, width, rough, seed, col){
  if (width <= 0) return sp;
  const pad = Math.round(width * 2.2) + 6;
  const w = sp.w + pad * 2, h = sp.h + pad * 2;
  const data = new Uint8ClampedArray(w * h * 4);
  for (let y = 0; y < sp.h; y++){
    const src = y * sp.w * 4;
    data.set(sp.data.subarray(src, src + sp.w * 4), ((y + pad) * w + pad) * 4);
  }

  const alpha = new Uint8ClampedArray(w * h);
  for (let i = 0; i < w * h; i++) alpha[i] = data[i * 4 + 3];
  const dist = distanceOutside(alpha, w, h);

  const nC = smoothNoise(w, h, Math.max(18, width * 2.2), seed);
  const nF = smoothNoise(w, h, Math.max(6, width * 0.6), seed + 7);
  const jag = 3;

  const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(w * h * 4);
  const FEATHER = 1.3;      // Breite des Deckungsuebergangs in Pixeln

  for (let y = 0; y < h; y++){
    const qy = Math.min(h - 1, (y / jag | 0) * jag);
    for (let x = 0; x < w; x++){
      const qx = Math.min(w - 1, (x / jag | 0) * jag);
      const qi = qy * w + qx, i = y * w + x, o = i * 4;

      // Die Schwelle wird blockweise quantisiert — daher kommt die zackige
      // Rissoptik. Der Abstand geht dagegen KONTINUIERLICH ein, sonst waere
      // auch die Kante selbst blockig statt nur ihr Verlauf.
      let th = width * (1 + rough * (0.75 * nC[qi] + 0.25 * nF[qi]));
      th = Math.max(width * 0.25, Math.min(width * 2, th));

      // Teildeckung am Rand statt harter Kante -> antialiaste Kontur
      const pa = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (th - dist[i]) / FEATHER + 0.5));
      const sa = data[o + 3] / 255;
      const a = sa + pa * (1 - sa);          // Sprite ueber Papier
      if (a <= 0.002){ out[o+3] = 0; continue; }

      const tex = 0.94 + 0.06 * nF[i];
      const pw = pa * (1 - sa);              // Anteil, den das Papier beitraegt
      out[o]   = (data[o]     * sa + col.r * tex * pw) / a;
      out[o+1] = (data[o + 1] * sa + col.g * tex * pw) / a;
      out[o+2] = (data[o + 2] * sa + col.b * tex * pw) / a;
      out[o+3] = a * 255;
    }
  }
  return { w, h, data: out };
}
